title: Erie Drifter Sportfishing & Lodging

services.name: Executive Charter
services.desc: Looking for a Lake Erie Fishing charter? Try Walleye charter fishing on Lake Erie with Erie Drifter, it’ll get you hooked! From ice out to November we run Lake Erie fishing charters, specifically Lake Erie Walleye fishing charters, Lake Erie Smallmouth Bass charters and Lake Erie Perch fishing charters. We are located at Wild Wings Marina and Campgrounds, which has excellent access to the fishing reefs. Right outside of our marina is the reef system that supports 90% of the spawn for Walleye for ALL OF LAKE ERIE! When that is done the SAME REEFS support a PROLIFIC Smallmouth Bass Spawn! Captains often boast that our location enables us to get you to the fish faster than other Lake Erie

blurb: Captain Stoney King and Captain Troy Wickman operate Erie Drifter Sportfishing & Lodging in Oak Harbor, OH. Their full time profession is running Lake Erie Fishing Charters.
